newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -Bunds to try for new gains above 102.00.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -Bunds to try for new gains above 102.00.

text.p: June Bund futures on LIFFE have the benefit of an uptrend since early April which should give them the strength to get back over 102.00 and keep rising, analysts said on Monday.
At 0654 GMT, the contract on LIFFE was at 101.88, up 11 basis points from Friday's finish.
"On the daily charts, with the lows we've set we're testing the longer term uptrend which started in April," said Geert-Jan Nikken, technical analyst at ABN AMRO Hoare Govett in Amsterdam.
"The picture remains bullish. Only prices below the 101.50-55 level would give you an intermediate bearish picture."
But Nikken saw resistance from 102.05 to 102.18 based on highs set in March. June Bunds set a 102.18 high on March 11. He also saw a 102.14 top on Friday as resistance within that band.
Tim Hampton, futures salesman at Royal Bank of Scotland in London, said the trend still favoured Bunds but indicators presented a mixed bag, making them vulnerable to a reversal.

"Despite Friday's selloff from 102.14 Bunds are still dominated by the rising channel from the 99.05 low," he said, referring to a trough made on April 3. "Strength on Monday is seen as a shorting opportunity but as this is against the major trend, small positions are recommended."
September Euromarks were at 96.75, up 0.01 from Friday.
They have been gradually trending higher since a 96.50 low on March 18 and have now breached a resistance level at 96.74, which had been the high for the previous four sessions.
The next major level on the charts is at 96.78, a top in late February, analysts said.
